# Advancing the Science of <span class="accent">Public Safety.</span>

::: {.hero-mission}
The El Paso Crime Lab is an independent research organization advancing the science of **crime, public safety, and criminal justice** through rigorous research, local data, and evidence.
:::

## What We Do

We turn research and local data into evidence that can be understood, examined, and used to improve public safety.

:::


::: {.areas}

::: {.area}

::: {.area-number}
01
:::

### Research

Conduct independent research on crime, public safety, and criminal justice issues affecting El Paso and the Borderland.

[Explore research →](dwi_home.html){.area-link}

:::


::: {.area}

::: {.area-number}
02
:::

### Data & Technical Assistance

Develop dashboards, data products, and analytical tools that help organizations understand local public safety problems and make better decisions.

[Explore the data →](crash_dashboard.html){.area-link}

:::


::: {.area}

::: {.area-number}
03
:::

### Community Information

Translate research and public safety information into accessible resources for residents, organizations, practitioners, and decision-makers.

[Find resources →](dwi_services.html){.area-link}

:::

:::

::: {.feature}

::: {.feature-label}
Current Research
:::

## Understanding impaired driving in El Paso

Our current research examines alcohol-impaired driving using local crash data, research evidence, and community information. Explore the dashboard, reports, findings, and local resources.

[Explore the DWI Research Hub →](dwi_home.html){.feature-action}

:::


::: {.feature-aside}

**Local problems require local evidence.**

Our goal is to make that evidence open, understandable, and useful.

:::
